/request-change 
/request-change

Update the BRD to clarify the Plan of Correction (POC) requirements and extraction evaluation criteria.

### 1. POC structure
The BRD currently states that the five-part POC structure needs to be validated with practicing nursing-home compliance reviewers.

Keep this as an open validation item, but explicitly state that the AI layer must generate a structured Plan of Correction for each individual Statement of Deficiency.

Do not invent or finalize the five POC sections without validation from the compliance stakeholders.

The specification should allow the POC structure to be defined/updated once the compliance team confirms the required sections.

### 2. Extraction success criterion
Update the success criterion:

"Detect every deficiency in the evaluation set or surface it as an uncertain candidate for human review."

to a measurable extraction target:

"Achieve at least 95% deficiency/SOD recall on the representative evaluation set, while ensuring missed, ambiguous, or low-confidence deficiencies are surfaced as candidates for human review."

Maintain the existing field-level accuracy target of at least 95% for provider name, F-tag, and complete SOD text.

### 3. Human review
Make clear that extraction recall and field-level accuracy are evaluation metrics, but the system must still provide human review of extracted information before a POC is generated/approved.

Do not make any other changes to the BRD.
